subject.title: feat(cua-computer): add experimental Windows/Linux computer-use fulfiller

question: Should OpenClaw ship `cua-computer` as a bundled experimental plugin that depends on a separately installed `cua-driver` desktop-control daemon, rather than keeping this capability external until its support and security boundary are accepted?
rationale: The implementation creates a new privileged, cross-platform computer-control product surface and a bundled dependency/support commitment; this cannot be resolved solely by patch correctness.

options.title: Sponsor bundled experimental plugin
options.body: Accept the bundled opt-in direction after native Windows/Linux proof and a focused daemon/dependency security review.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Ask for the fulfiller to be distributed as an external plugin until maintainers want to own its bundled support and security boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled experimental plugin
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled opt-in direction after native Windows/Linux proof and a focused daemon/dependency security review.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the merged capability prerequisite and the proposed implementation, making them the clearest available routing candidate for the intended product boundary.
